clips.text: The other thing what I've learned from the playoffs is like we need more playmakers besides him and Donovan Mitchell. We have to encourage the Jalen Tysons, the Payton Watsons, our role players to be more aggressive if that makes sense.
clips.news_angle: Kenny Atkinson on the need for more playmakers beyond the stars

clips.pull_quote: We need more playmakers besides him and Donovan Mitchell.

clips.speaker: Peyton Watson
clips.text: Obviously I would say just the organization and how well-run it is. It reminds me of Denver, very serious off top, really emphasizing our habits and building those consistencies throughout the season. Off the court, there has been so much team building and camaraderie building exercises that we have done, and we have really been getting along. I think that goes a long way, and us liking each other off the court will continue to help our chemistry on.
clips.news_angle: Peyton Watson on the organizational similarities between the Cavaliers and Nuggets
clips.social_post: Peyton Watson says the Cavaliers organization reminds him of Denver in terms of how serious they are about building habits and consistency.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: It reminds me of Denver, very serious off top, really emphasizing our habits and building those consistencies.

clips.speaker: Peyton Watson
clips.text: I want to be really versatile for this team and provide that punch and that young energy that we need. First and foremost, speaking defensively, just being the anchor of our defense and really being someone who is loud and vocal on that end. Just helping guys out in any way that I can and making things easier on that end of the floor. Then also on offense, just my mind for the game. I have really learned how to read the game well playing on championship-contending teams since I have been in the league.
clips.news_angle: Peyton Watson on his defensive role and versatility for the Cavaliers
clips.social_post: Peyton Watson says he wants to be the anchor of the Cavaliers defense and provide a punch of young energy for the team this season.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: I want to be really versatile for this team and provide that punch and that young energy.

clips.speaker: Peyton Watson
clips.text: I think the upside is the greatest, just being an extremely elite two-way player. I think that I really have all the tools to affect the game on both sides of the floor. I have already shown flashes of being an elite defender and I am going to continue to put that together over a whole season and push myself to be an All-NBA defensive player. But at the same time, just my promise offensively, I have got a smooth shot, my handle is really good, and like I said, I have got a good mind for the game.
clips.news_angle: Peyton Watson on his potential as an elite two-way player
clips.social_post: Peyton Watson has big goals for his time in Cleveland, stating he is pushing himself to become an All-NBA defensive player.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: I think that I really have all the tools to affect the game on both sides.

clips.speaker: Peyton Watson
clips.text: It is amazing just knowing in the back of my head that I can play aggressively and super physically out front, knowing that I have those guys behind me. And then also those guys just emphasizing being more vocal on the floor this year is really going to help me out because it is going to allow me to just be up top and guard without having to be looking around or wondering what is going on behind me. I know those guys have it down pat.
clips.news_angle: Peyton Watson on the defensive impact of playing with Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen
clips.social_post: Peyton Watson says having Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen behind him allows him to play more aggressively and physically on the perimeter.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: It is amazing just knowing in the back of my head that I can play aggressively.

clips.speaker: Peyton Watson
clips.text: I think just to make them uncomfortable as possible, to disrupt a little bit. I have these unique qualities that allow me to kind of be a defensive playmaker. One thing I have been working on since I got in the league was my discipline and being a solid defender. I think that I have always had the ability to make those plays up at the rim, block shots on the perimeter, play the passing lanes, get steals. Now I feel like I am going to be more empowered having that backline behind me.
clips.news_angle: Peyton Watson on his defensive approach against elite offensive players
clips.social_post: Peyton Watson on his defensive mindset: I have unique qualities that allow me to be a defensive playmaker and I want to make opponents as uncomfortable as possible.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: I think just to make them uncomfortable as possible, to disrupt a little bit.

clips.speaker: Peyton Watson
clips.text: It just takes a lot of mental toughness. I think it takes a lot of resilience throughout the season, as we see the East is as strong as it has ever been. I think that is going to be a good test for us in the regular season for us to face some adversity and some challenges and learn more about ourselves. I think you learn the most about yourself when you are facing times of uncertainty and uncomfortability.
clips.news_angle: Peyton Watson on the mental toughness needed to compete for a championship
clips.social_post: Peyton Watson believes the strength of the Eastern Conference will be a good test for the Cavaliers to face adversity and learn about themselves.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: It just takes a lot of mental toughness. I think it takes a lot of resilience.

clips.speaker: Peyton Watson
clips.text: I think a lot of the pressure is on those guys. They are getting guarded and scouted for with the best of them. These guys have been elite players now for so long, that is music to my ears when I hear that I am going to be able to catch the ball in a position to kind of make some plays and make the game easier for them and for my other teammates as well. So I am extremely excited to be able to step into that role and provide that punch.
clips.news_angle: Peyton Watson on taking the pressure off Donovan Mitchell and Darius Garland
clips.social_post: Peyton Watson is ready to step into a role that makes the game easier for Donovan Mitchell and Darius Garland by taking some of the pressure off them.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: That is music to my ears when I hear that I am going to be able to.

clips.speaker: Peyton Watson
clips.text: It definitely taught me a lot about my positioning, how to cut, where to be at the right place at the right time, and how to make his job easier. So I definitely learned a lot about what windows to be in and how to move off the ball to help those star guys out. It will be a little bit different obviously playing with a center and then playing with guards who more so have the ball, but I will be able to fit in wherever I can.
clips.news_angle: Peyton Watson on what he learned playing alongside Nikola Jokic
clips.social_post: Peyton Watson says playing with Nikola Jokic taught him a lot about positioning and how to move off the ball to help star players.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: It definitely taught me a lot about my positioning, how to cut, where to be.

clips.speaker: Peyton Watson
clips.text: I mean, I think in general, the Lakers have a big social media following, the Clippers as well, and I am a kid from LA. So you know, I think that would be in their ideal world, the story that works for them. But the whole time it was out of my hands regardless. I was a restricted free agent and I think a lot of people misconstrue that. I think a lot of people think that I had the choice of where I wanted to go, and it was more so not in my hands. It was about the trade that Denver wanted to take or they wanted to retain me.
clips.news_angle: Peyton Watson on the trade rumors involving the Lakers and Clippers
clips.social_post: Peyton Watson clarifies his trade rumors: It was out of my hands. I was a restricted free agent and it was about the trade Denver wanted to take.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: I was a restricted free agent and I think a lot of people misconstrue that.

clips.speaker: Peyton Watson
clips.text: I think it starts on the defensive end. I think that we have guys who can score, we have dynamic players, we have guys who are perennial All-Stars and then we have guys who are capable of being All-Stars. So I think that offensively, that will always continue to get better and better as the season goes on, but I think us setting the tone defensively and really being a team that protects the paint and guards the three-point line well will definitely propel us to where we want to be.
clips.news_angle: Peyton Watson on why the Cavaliers can reach the top of the East
clips.social_post: Peyton Watson believes the Cavaliers path to the top of the East starts on the defensive end by protecting the paint and guarding the three point line.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: I think it starts on the defensive end. I think that we have guys who can score.

clips.speaker: Peyton Watson
clips.text: It is really hard to say because you never know what the teams even look like coming into the end of the season. Like health plays a big part in how a lot of the seasons go. There are a lot of great, great teams in the East and a lot of great talent. You know, Miami has got Giannis, like I said, Philly has done a lot with their roster as well. Then obviously the Pacers are getting back healthy, they were in the championship two years ago, you can never count them out.
clips.news_angle: Peyton Watson on the competitive landscape of the Eastern Conference
clips.social_post: Peyton Watson on the Eastern Conference: There are a lot of great teams and talent, you can never count anyone out.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: There are a lot of great, great teams in the East and a lot of great talent.

clips.speaker: Peyton Watson
clips.text: I think definitely just working on continuing to shoot the ball at an elite level. I have really raised my three-point acumen and I have gotten really, really good with that, and that has allowed me to be guarded in a way that opens up the strengths in my game. And what comes naturally to me, which is slashing, getting to the rim, finishing above the rim, and I think also getting stronger as well, just being able to take contact better and being able to be more durable throughout the season.
clips.news_angle: Peyton Watson on his focus on three-point shooting and physical development
clips.social_post: Peyton Watson says he has raised his three point acumen to open up his game and is focused on getting stronger to be more durable this season.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: I think definitely just working on continuing to shoot the ball at an elite level.

clips.speaker: Peyton Watson
clips.text: We got some amazing guys on the team. Every individual presents their own unique personality and that is what I love about the team, nobody is afraid to be themselves. And I think that that will really shine on the court as well because we got guys who are not afraid, we got guys who know what they are going out there to do and we have true professionals on the team. So I think that I fit in perfectly with that because that is what I have been doing for my whole career.
clips.news_angle: Peyton Watson on the team culture and personality of the Cavaliers
clips.social_post: Peyton Watson says he fits in perfectly with the Cavaliers because the team is full of true professionals who are not afraid to be themselves.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: We got some amazing guys on the team. Every individual presents their own unique personality.

clips.speaker: Evan Mobley
clips.text: I think everything just has to be upped. I don't think we have to necessarily change too much. We did a great job last season overall, but I think we just have to up certain attributes and certain statistics like rebounding and physicality. It was all there before, but I think we just have to up everything.

clips.social_post: Evan Mobley says the Cavs do not need to change their identity but must up their intensity in key areas. He specifically identified rebounding and physicality as the two stats the team needs to improve this season.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Evan Mobley Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: I think we just have to up certain attributes and certain statistics like rebounding and physicality.

clips.speaker: Evan Mobley
clips.text: He's been great. He's definitely his own leader in his own way as well. He's vocal. He's learned a lot over at Denver, so he has some stuff to say as well throughout our drills and the stuff that we're doing. I mean, he's obviously athletic, so I see some crazy defensive plays so far, and I think his shot is great as well for us. So, I think he's going to be a great addition to our team.
clips.news_angle: Evan Mobley praises Peyton Watson's impact during training camp
clips.social_post: Evan Mobley is impressed with Peyton Watson in training camp. Mobley highlighted Watson's vocal leadership and athleticism, calling him a great addition to the team.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Evan Mobley Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: He's definitely his own leader in his own way as well. He's vocal.

clips.speaker: Evan Mobley
clips.text: Like you said, a legend. It's crazy that I get to play with him and be around him every day and learn from him. It's surreal in a way. But as I get to know him every single day, he's a great guy, just a normal dude just like all of us. I feel that's a big factor that a lot of people hold people on pedestals, but he's just a normal guy just like all of us. I feel that gives everyone else confidence that he has a good personality, natural personality, and gets along with everyone. He's not trying to big-time anyone or anything like that.
clips.news_angle: Evan Mobley on James Harden's personality and leadership
clips.social_post: Evan Mobley on playing with James Harden: It is surreal to be around a legend every day, but he is just a normal guy. Mobley says Harden has a great personality and is not trying to big time anyone.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Evan Mobley Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: He's a normal dude just like all of us. I feel that's a big factor.

clips.speaker: Evan Mobley
clips.text: I'm definitely going to still maintain my defensive game for the most part. That's always going to be number one. That's the natural thing that comes to me. But offensively, I'm definitely going to focus on that as well. That's a big focus that I've been focusing on in the summer and working on. And I think once both meet together, I'm going to be one of the best players. So, I think that's what I really got to focus on right now is both sides, maintaining the defensive but also still working on the offensive side as well.
clips.news_angle: Evan Mobley's focus on maintaining defensive dominance while improving offensively
clips.social_post: Evan Mobley says his goal is to maintain his defensive dominance while taking a leap on the offensive end. He believes that once both sides of his game meet together he will be one of the best players in the league.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Evan Mobley Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: I'm definitely going to still maintain my defensive game for the most part.

clips.speaker: Evan Mobley
clips.text: I think offensively, I got to simplify my game just like how I was just talking about with Kevin Garnett and Tim Duncan. They had a very simple package and they got to their spots and just elevated very simply. So, that's what I'm trying to do as well. And defensively, just probably being more physical in certain areas on the floor and just asserting my dominance.
clips.news_angle: Evan Mobley's goals for simplifying his offensive game
clips.social_post: Evan Mobley is looking to simplify his offensive game by studying Kevin Garnett and Tim Duncan. He wants to get to his spots and elevate simply while being more physical on the defensive end.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Evan Mobley Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: I got to simplify my game just like how I was just talking about with Kevin Garnett.

clips.speaker: Evan Mobley
clips.text: I think it's both, on-court and off-court. I feel the most together teams are the ones that are winning the championship recently. So, doing stuff like this, coming to Spain, doing different activities, and bringing the team together is really important. So, when we get in tough situations, we know how to operate with each other.
clips.news_angle: Evan Mobley on the importance of team chemistry for winning championships
clips.social_post: Evan Mobley emphasizes the importance of team chemistry for championship success. He says that doing activities together off the court is vital for knowing how to operate when the team gets into tough situations.
clips.video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Evan Mobley Media Availability | 10.02.2026
clips.pull_quote: The most together teams are the ones that are winning the championship recently.

clips.speaker: Deni Avdija
clips.text: Scoot looks great. Shape-wise, body-wise, he looks strong. He looks aggressive, he attacks the rim. He is shooting it way better. So obviously we all can see how much he spent during the off-season to improve his game and I think the sky's the limit for Scoot, and we really need him this year to make another step.
clips.news_angle: Deni Avdija on Scoot Henderson's physical and skill development
clips.social_post: Deni Avdija is impressed with Scoot Henderson this preseason, noting that he looks stronger and is shooting the ball much better. Avdija says the sky is the limit for Scoot and the team needs him to take another step this year.
clips.video_title: Deni Avdija Media Availability | Oct. 1, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers
clips.pull_quote: I think the sky's the limit for Scoot, and we really need him this year to make another step.

clips.speaker: Deni Avdija
clips.text: I definitely had a lot of offensive load last year, especially during the middle of the season. I had all that back injury stuff that kind of held me back, but at the end of the day, I'm trying to be a complete player on both ends of the floor. I'm trying to be a good defensive player and just continue what I do on offense. I'm going to work on my shape, I'm going to compete every possession, and I think this year I'll try to make the next step on the defensive end as well.
clips.news_angle: Deni Avdija on his goal to become a complete two-way player
clips.social_post: Deni Avdija is focused on becoming a complete two-way player for the Blazers this season. He says he is aiming to make the next step on the defensive end while continuing to contribute on offense.
clips.video_title: Deni Avdija Media Availability | Oct. 1, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers
clips.pull_quote: At the end of the day, I'm trying to be a complete player on both ends of the floor.

clips.speaker: Deni Avdija
clips.text: I had to figure out my offensive load. I shot a lot off the dribble this year. I had a lot of fatigue towards the end of games and a lot of times there wasn't a lot of catch-and-shoots or open shots. I had to figure out new types of shots that I've never really shot before. I'm not shy to shoot. I think I'm a good shooter, I have a good technique. I'm working on my shot, I keep trusting it, and I feel like the percentage matters, but in the end of the day, if you are confident in your shot and you keep shooting them with confidence, you're knocking them down when you need to.
clips.news_angle: Deni Avdija on adjusting his offensive game and shot selection
clips.social_post: Deni Avdija reflects on his shot selection last season, noting he had to take difficult shots due to fatigue and offensive load. He remains confident in his technique and says he will keep shooting with confidence.
clips.video_title: Deni Avdija Media Availability | Oct. 1, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers
clips.pull_quote: I'm not shy to shoot. I think I'm a good shooter, I have a good technique.

clips.speaker: Deni Avdija
clips.text: We all do both. I feel like that's a winning team mentality. Each and every one of us got to understand that we got to play a little bit off the ball sometimes and it's fine. We're not expecting Scoot to have the ball 48 minutes and just dribble and go. We got good creators, we got good drivers. Obviously somebody hot, we're going to feed off them, but every player in the team is important and every player in the team will have opportunity to initiate and create. I think we just read and feed off each other.
clips.news_angle: Deni Avdija on team mentality and sharing playmaking duties

clips.video_title: Deni Avdija Media Availability | Oct. 1, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers
clips.pull_quote: Each and every one of us got to understand that we got to play a little bit off the ball.

clips.text: I think I would leave some surprises for the season. I'm not going to tell you all the secrets.

clips.pull_quote: I think I would leave some surprises for the season. I'm not going to tell you all the secrets.

clips.text: The thing that we're trying to do with Scoot is continue to play with pace. The things I just tell him is just go as fast as you can. If somebody's in front of you, pass it. So we're trying to stress the mind just as much as we are physically. I identified why, and it started with our defensive intensity, making sure we're starting every play 94 feet.
